snippet.description:
Some critics say synthetic biology’s promises are too utopian, or that the technology will not develop quickly enough to matter. Kate Adamala sees today’s early experiments differently: as the field’s version of the Wright brothers’ first flight.

On this week’s episode of Unexplainable, the University of Minnesota synthetic biologist explains why she believes the technology could advance faster than skeptics expect.
